_comment: Agent and model selection for agent-ops-kit. Copy to $HOME/.config/agent-ops-kit/agents.json and edit the entries and lanes for your environment. The adapter field names a directory under scripts/agents/. Lane order was set by the ops lane on behalf of the maintainer. A null model id is unverified: TODO confirm it locally; agent-launch exits 2 for that entry until it is set. overages is never for every agent: paid overages are not allowed.

goat._comment: Fixed-quota plan. Adapter: scripts/agents/goat (patch and review are read-only; write mode is gated, see docs/goat-adapter.md).

agy-subscription._comment: Consumer subscription seat. The terms allow interactive use by the maintainer only, so bots never launch this entry. Coding uses the issue hand-off mode: the bot prepares an agent-task Issue and the maintainer runs agy remotely from it.

agy-api-key._comment: Gemini API-key mode (pay as you go). Disabled: no API key and no budget cap yet, so provisioned stays false and selection skips it.

codex._comment: Consumer plan seat (fixed quota): maintainer-only under the plan terms. No codex adapter ships yet, so provisioned stays false.

opencode-fireworks._comment: Prepaid Fireworks credits with rollover; used after the fixed-quota agents run out. Adapter not shipped yet.

cursor._comment: Shares quota with chat: small tasks only, and keep 20% of the weekly quota for chat. Adapter not shipped yet.

coding._comment: Fixed-quota agents first (GOAT, agy, Codex), then OpenCode with prepaid Fireworks credits, and Cursor last because it shares quota with chat. The agy entry is an issue hand-off for remote maintainer runs.

entries._comment: Hand-off: agent-launch --dry-run prints the agent-task-issue.sh command; the maintainer runs agy from the Issue. In issue mode no model is executed, so a null id is allowed and passed as "id unverified". TODO: model id unverified (no run record); the maintainer confirms it locally.
